rw.name: Mookie Betts
rw.head: Delivers three hits in loss
rw.blurb: Betts went 3-for-5 with a double, a walk and a run scored in Thursday's 4-2 loss to the Padres.

rw.name: Tyler Glasnow
rw.head: Dials up 11 strikeouts
rw.blurb: Glasnow (5-2) allowed three runs on three hits and two walks while striking out 11 over 6.1 innings to take the loss versus the Padres on Thursday.

rw.name: Fernando Tatis
rw.head: Adds two steals
rw.blurb: Tatis went 2-for-3 with a walk, one RBI and two stolen bases in Thursday's 4-2 win over the Dodgers.

rw.name: Mason Miller
rw.head: Allows run in save
rw.blurb: Miller allowed a run on one hit and struck out two over one inning to earn the save in Thursday's 4-2 win over the Dodgers.

rw.name: Julio Rodriguez
rw.head: Launches homer in loss
rw.blurb: Rodriguez went 2-for-4 with a two-run home run in Thursday's 6-4 loss to the Angels.

rw.name: Jeremy Pena
rw.head: Nabs steal in return to lineup
rw.blurb: Pena went 1-for-5 with a stolen base in Thursday's 7-5 win over the Athletics.

rw.name: Lucas Spence
rw.head: Surprise source of power
rw.blurb: Spence went 3-for-4 with three home runs and five RBI in Thursday's 7-5 win over the Athletics.

rw.name: Willson Contreras
rw.head: Uncertain for wild-card round
rw.blurb: Contreras (hand) expressed concern Thursday about his availability for Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series next week, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports. "I'm working hard with the trainers, the hand is slowly getting better," Contreras said. "But I haven't been able to swing the last two days. I'll be honest with the team. I know Tuesday is a really important game. It's a really important series, and I'll be completely honest with the team."

rw.name: William Contreras
rw.head: Lifted due to lack of hustle
rw.blurb: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said after Thursday's 5-1 win over the Phillies that he removed Contreras for a pinch hitter late because the backstop didn't run out a grounder he could have gotten a hit on, Curt Hogg of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.

rw.name: Brendan Beck
rw.head: Starting first game Friday
rw.blurb: Beck will be recalled from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre to start the first game of Friday's doubleheader against the Orioles, Alex Diaz of WFUV Sports reports.

rw.name: Luis Arraez
rw.head: Suffers sprained ankle
rw.blurb: Arraez suffered a sprained left ankle during Thursday's contest against the Brewers, Lochlahn March of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

rw.name: Jeremy Pena
rw.head: Back in starting lineup
rw.blurb: Pena (wrist) is starting at shortstop and batting leadoff for Thursday night's matchup against the Athletics, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.

rw.name: Miguel Vargas
rw.head: Steals 21st base
rw.blurb: Vargas went 2-for-5 with two RBI, two runs, one walk, one stolen base and three strikeouts during Thursday's 9-1 win over the Royals.

rw.name: Ian Happ
rw.head: Triples, scores in win
rw.blurb: Happ went 1-for-3 with a walk, a triple and a run scored in Thursday's 2-1 win over the Marlins.

rw.name: Dalton Rushing
rw.head: Expected to be activated Friday
rw.blurb: Rushing (elbow) is expected to be activated from the 10-day injured list Friday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.

rw.name: Paul Skenes
rw.head: Reaches 200 Ks for 2026
rw.blurb: Skenes did not factor into the decision Thursday, allowing one run on three hits and two walks over 6.1 innings against the Cardinals. He struck out eight.

rw.name: Martin Perez
rw.head: Lands on injured list
rw.blurb: Atlanta placed Perez on the 15-day injured list Thursday with lower-back inflammation, Jesus Cano of The Athletic reports.

rw.name: Jonathan Aranda
rw.head: On bench Thursday
rw.blurb: Aranda isn't in the lineup for Thursday's game against the Yankees, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.

rw.name: Ronald Acuna
rw.head: Back in action Thursday
rw.blurb: Acuna (leg) will start in right field and will bat second in Thursday's game against the Reds.

rw.name: Jazz Chisholm
rw.head: Taking seat Thursday
rw.blurb: Chisholm isn't in the lineup for Thursday's game against the Rays.

rw.name: Alex Bregman
rw.head: Resumes hitting
rw.blurb: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Thursday that Bregman (face) resumed hitting Wednesday and it "went well," per Patrick Mooney of The Athletic.

rw.name: Sandy Alcantara
rw.head: Won't make start this weekend
rw.blurb: Marlins manager Clayton McCullough said Thursday that Alcantara will not make a start this weekend against Atlanta, Stephen Strom of Marlins Radio Network reports.

rw.name: Kevin Gausman
rw.head: Left shoulder remains sore
rw.blurb: Gausman said Thursday that his left shoulder remains sore and he's uncertain when he will be available to pitch, Bruce Levine of 670TheScore.com reports.

rw.name: Kyle Stowers
rw.head: Sitting out versus left-hander
rw.blurb: Stowers is absent from the lineup for Thursday's contest versus the Cubs.

rw.name: Xavier Edwards
rw.head: Remains out of lineup
rw.blurb: Edwards (thumb) remains out of the lineup for Thursday's contest versus the Cubs.
